profile.headline: Software Engineer | Active TS/SCI Security Clearance
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with strong UI/UX design skills. Possesses strong knowledge of Angular Framework, ReactJS, Java Spring Boot, Next.js, HTML5/CSS3 coding standards and OOP/scripting languages.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and maintained the OIS NextGen application for the Department of Navy using Java SpringBoot 3, ReactJS, TypeScript, PostgreSQL and Kubernetes.

Collaborated with cross-functional teams to add Microservices, modify API endpoints to satisfy business rules, and optimize user functionality.

Developed unit tests for custom Java classes and React components, ensuring robust functionality and adherence to best practices.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Spring Boot · Java · React.js · Microservices

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and maintained the Sybil application for DARPA using PayloadCMS, Python, ReactJS, TypeScript, NextJS, ShadCN, and TailwindCSS.

Collaborated with cross-functional teams to enhance application features, create API endpoints, and optimize performance.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Next.js · JavaScript · Gitlab · Git · Shadcn · Tailwind CSS · Microsoft Visual Studio Code · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · HTML5 · Software Infrastructure

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and maintained the DISA StoreFront application, leveraging jQuery, ReactJS, JavaScript, SQL Database, and Java/C# backend.

Refactored legacy code, troubleshooting and resolving defects while expanding functionality.
Created and unit-tested RESTful API endpoints to enhance application capabilities.

Created and unit-tested RESTful API endpoints to enhance application capabilities.
positions.insights: Skills: jQuery · JavaScript · Oracle Database · SQL · JSON · CLI · User Interface Design · CSS · Bootstrap (Framework)

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Developed a software application for the Department of Defense using Angular 13, Bootstrap, JavaScript, Swagger API, jQuery, and TypeScript.

Collaborated with backend developers to integrate APIs and ensure smooth data flow between front-end and back-end systems.
positions.insights: Skills: Cloud Computing · Angular Command Line Interface (CLI) · LESS (Stylesheet Language) · C# · Adobe Creative Suite · JavaScript Libraries · Node.js · JavaScript · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Angular · Angular Material · HTML5 · JSON
